story-context.constraints: - Schema changes limited to: EnvironmentConfig.price_series_path, RedemptionConfig.capacity_schedule, and the content_hash extension. Both new fields default to absent; every existing scenario's content_hash must be unchanged (test: baseline hash still 2e09f431ce74… or whatever the pinned value is; the determinism fixtures must not need updating). - No kernel/ changes. PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1. - When price_series_path is set, volatility_per_step must be 0 and shocks must be empty; validator error names the rule. - price_series_path is resolved relative to the scenario YAML's directory, not the CWD; the manifest stores the resolved absolute path AND the series sha256. - capacity_schedule steps strictly ascending; applied at the start of PROTOCOL_EVENTS for that step, before process(); emits capacity_changed {step, old, new}. - pace is chosen by the scan rule in AC 8 (closest trough timing to the observed), not by eye. - The overlay chart re-reads the CSV named in the manifest; it must not take the series as an argument. - VALIDATION.md states what matches, what doesn't, and why, in that order. - Python 3.12-compatible.
